exercises.q: Do you know any Finnish tongue-twisters?
exercises.why: **скороговорки** — скорогово́рка: tongue-twister (phrase which is difficult to say); rapid speech, sputter. Wiktionary: ско́рый + -о- + говори́ть + -ка.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to talk, to have a talk, to speak (to, with)
tongue-twister (phrase which is difficult to say)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: переговори́ть — to talk, to have a talk, to speak (to, with); договори́ть — to finish speaking/saying/telling; скорогово́рка — tongue-twister (phrase which is difficult to say); угово́р — persuasion, plural remonstrance.
**поговорка** — погово́рка: saying, proverb, byword (concise, descriptive folk phrase).
